_note: Opening cutscene: the Incendium, as told by the Pig Lord. Source: 'The Incendium' lore doc. One entry per beat.
title: The Incendium
narrator: as remembered by the Pig Lord

beats.heading: The Eruption of Yellowstone
beats.text: Humans thought Yellowstone would sleep for thousands of years. It woke instead, and a winter of ash and sulfur covered the world for a decade.

beats.heading: Cataclysm
beats.text: The farms died under the ash. Famine turned neighbours against each other, and fights over food became wars between nations.

beats.heading: The Incendium
beats.text: The wars merged into one: the Incendium, 'inferno' in the Menslosian tongue. Old alliances broke, old empires rose again, and the nuclear fire began.

beats.heading: Deformation of Nations
beats.text: Radiation and winter took billions. In bunkers the humans never noticed, pigs and chickens grew wiser, learned tools, and waited.

beats.heading: A Message from J82wC4
beats.text: Lightyears away, a civilization near utopia watched the war and sent a message. To this day no one has deciphered it. When the bombs stopped, only three humans remained.

beats.heading: Continental Merge
beats.text: The plates drifted together into one supercontinent. The animals came out of hiding to claim a silent, desolate land.

beats.heading: The Universal Merge
beats.text: A flash of light and colour split the sky. Through the fissures came a chain of floating islands, a portal sealed in an unbreakable barrier, staircases in Sylvania, and things that cannot be described. The universe split in two.

beats.heading: A New Beginning
beats.text: Villages became towns and towns became cities. We took control of Menslosia and established order. The floating islands were inhabited, and they became the nation of Skyfall.

beats.heading: The Arcadian Era
beats.text: The Incendium is over. Two nations share a new world: Menslosia below, Skyfall above. Every leap year, the Black Moon rises over the barrier. Choose your nation.
